name: Creator LMS – Online Courses and eLearning Plugin
author: WPFunnels

sections.description:
Creator LMS is a complete WordPress plugin built specifically for creators, coaches, and educators who want to create, sell, and manage online courses without technical complexity or expensive add-ons.

Creator LMS focuses on a fast way to launch courses. It is designed to engage students with cohorts and community features. Sell memberships, subscriptions and charge one time fees with the built in eCommerce features.

See Creator LMS in action:

The core plugin is 100% FREE forever with unlimited courses, students, lessons, quizzes, certificates, and native checkout with Stripe.

🚀 Live Demo | 📘 Documentation | 🎥 Video Tutorials | 💁‍♂️ Facebook Community | 🗺️ Public Roadmap

Why Choose Creator LMS?

Built for Creators, Not Complexity

Most WordPress LMS plugins require extensive technical knowledge, and force you to install 10+ additional plugins just to get basic features working.

It is the best WordPress LMS plugin for:

✨ Solo course creators launching their first product
👨‍🏫 Coaches and consultants running cohort-based programs
🎓 Educators building engaged learning communities
🏢 Small agencies who need to deliver LMS sites fast
💼 Trainers creating employee development programs

Our WordPress Course Plugin has everything you need!

  • ✅ AI-powered course outline creation – OpenAI and Anthropic integrated. Generate course plans within minutes and we do professional prompt engineering for you in the background.
  • ✅ Content Protection – Our system automatically blurs the screen when someone tries to use a recording software.
  • ✅ Built-in community platform – Let students post their confusions and let them help themselves.
  • ✅ Native eCommerce built-in – Accept payments via Stripe, PayPal, Authorize.net, Mollie, Razorpay without any additional plugin.
  • ✅ Cohort-based learning – Run live, time-based courses with student cohorts.
  • ✅ One-click upsells – Monetize without complex funnel builders.
  • ✅ Advanced email automation – Keep students engaged with Mail Mint integration.
  • ✅ Gamification included – Badges, leaderboards, and rewards built-in. No additional plugin needed.
  • ✅ Analytics – Track student performance, progress, and revenue with an analytical view.
  • ✅ Theme Compatibility – Works with 30+ popular WordPress themes and page builders.
  • ✅ Builder Integration – Special widgets for Gutenberg, Elementor, and Bricks Builder.
  • ✅ Google Meet and Zoom Integration – Take live classes on your preferred platform and tool.

Launch Your First Course in 3 Simple Steps:

  1. Share some information with our AI assistant about you, the course topic and student demographics.
  2. Work on the suggested contents.
  3. Upload them and hit publish!

Our WordPress LMS plugin is designed to get you from idea to revenue faster than any other WordPress course plugin; without sacrificing the advanced features you’ll need as you scale.

Who’s Creator LMS Perfect For?

This WordPress LMS plugin is designed for anyone who wants to share knowledge and monetize their expertise online:

👨‍💼 Solo Course Creators
Launch your first online course without the overwhelm. Creator LMS gives you everything you need in one plugin. No technical expertise required, no expensive add-ons to buy.

👩‍🏫 Coaches & Consultants
Run live cohort-based programs where students start together, learn together, and complete together. Perfect for group coaching programs and mentorship courses.

🎓 Online Educators
Create effective learning experiences with quizzes, assignments, certificates, and community features. Build a platform where students don’t just consume content, they get assessment reports and certificates to share.

🏢 Agencies & Developers
Buil online course selling websites for clients faster with fewer plugins and dependencies. Creator LMS’s all-in-one approach means less troubleshooting, less maintenance, and happier clients.

💼 Corporate Trainers
Build internal courses employee training programs with progress tracking, assessments, and completion certificates. Track team learning and development all in one eLearning platform.

🌟 Membership Site Owners
Combine courses with community features to create recurring-revenue streams. Keep members engaged month after month.

📈 Digital Marketers
Use built-in one-click offers to maximize customer value. Upsell advanced courses, cohort access, and premium content without complex funnel builders.

🏗️ Intuitive Course Builder

Create best selling online courses in minutes with Creator LMS’s drag-and-drop course builder. This WordPress LMS plugin is designed specifically for creators—not developers.

Multiple Lesson Types

  • Video Lessons – Upload videos, embed from YouTube/Vimeo, or use your preferred video hosting
  • Audio Lessons – Perfect for podcast-style courses or music instruction
  • Text Lessons – Rich text editing with formatting, images, and embeds
  • Downloadable Resources – PDFs, worksheets, templates, and more
  • Mixed Media – Combine video, text, and downloads in a single lesson

Course Organization

Create unlimited chapters to organize lessons into logical sections. Add descriptions to each chapter, set prerequisites between lessons, and control the flow of your course content.

Lesson Preview

Let potential students preview select lessons before enrolling. Show them the quality of your content and teaching style to increase conversions.

Custom Course Layouts

Choose from multiple professionally-designed course layout templates. Match your course presentation to your teaching style and brand aesthetic.

Quick Course Creation

With AI assistant, generate complete course outlines in seconds. The AI creates lesson structures, chapter organization, and even suggests content—all you need to do is refine and add your unique expertise.

🧩 Powerful Quiz & Assessment System

Test student knowledge and boost engagement with Creator LMS’s flexible quiz builder supporting 6+ question types.

Comprehensive Question Types

  • Multiple Choice
  • Single Choice
  • True / False
  • Short & Long Text
  • Fill In The Blank
  • Reorder
  • Image Matching

💳 Native eCommerce – Sell Courses Your Way

Our WordPress LMS plugin includes a complete native checkout system built specifically for selling online courses—no WooCommerce required.

Why Native eCommerce Matters

Traditional LMS plugins often require additional eCommerce plugins, creating complexity and potential conflicts. Creator LMS takes a different approach: streamlined checkout designed specifically for course sales.

Built-In Payment Processing

Accept payments with Stripe (included free), Mollie, and offline payments right out of the box. Pro adds PayPal, Authorize.net, and Razorpay for global payment flexibility.

Seamless Checkout Experience

Students go from course page to enrolled in seconds with our optimized checkout flow. No cart abandonment, no complex checkout fields—just simple, fast course purchase.

Order Management

View all orders for your WordPress LMS in one dashboard. Track revenue, manage refunds, update order status, and export order data for accounting—all without leaving WordPress.

Flexible Pricing Models

  • One-time course purchases
  • Course bundles and packages
  • Subscription and membership access (Pro)
  • Installment payment plans (Pro)
  • Free courses with optional upsells
  • Pay-what-you-want pricing
  • Coupon codes and discounts
  • Limited-time sale pricing

Revenue Analytics

Track total revenue, average order value, conversion rates, and sales trends over time. Export financial reports from your WordPress LMS for tax preparation and business planning.

👥 Cohort-Based Learning – Run Live Programs

Transform passive course consumption into active learning experiences with cohort-based courses where students learn together, on a schedule.

What Are Cohorts?

Cohorts are groups of students who start a course at the same time and progress through it together on a set schedule. Instead of self-paced learning, cohort-based courses create accountability, peer interaction, and higher completion rates.

Perfect For:

  • Group coaching programs
  • Bootcamp-style intensive courses
  • Mastermind communities
  • Corporate training sessions
  • Semester-based education
  • Live workshop series

Cohort Management Features

  • Set specific start and end dates for each cohort
  • Enroll students in specific cohorts
  • Create multiple cohorts for the same course
  • Manage waitlists for upcoming cohorts
  • Cohort-specific announcements and updates
  • Track progress for entire cohorts
  • Schedule content release by cohort

Higher Engagement, Better Results

Cohort-based courses create urgency (deadlines), accountability (peer progress), and community (shared experience). Students are 3-5x more likely to complete cohort-based courses vs. self-paced.

Monetization Benefits

Charge premium pricing for cohort access. Create scarcity with limited cohort sizes. Run multiple cohorts throughout the year for predictable recurring revenue.

Live Learning Integration

Schedule live sessions, Q&A calls, and group workshops within your cohort timeline. Students see upcoming live events on their dashboard and receive automatic reminders.

🏘️ Community Platform – Keep Students Engaged

Our WordPress LMS plugin helps you create thriving learning communities where students connect, collaborate, and support each other—without installing separate forum or community plugins.

Why Community Matters

Courses with active communities have 70%+ higher completion rates. When students connect with peers, ask questions, and share progress, they stay engaged …
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Creator LMS”
  4. Click “Install Now” on the Creator LMS plugin
  5. After installation, click “Activate”
  6. Follow the setup wizard to configure your LMS

Need help getting started? Watch our complete setup tutorial

sections.faq:
Is Creator LMS free to use?

Yes! The core Creator LMS plugin is 100% free and includes everything you need to create and sell online courses: unlimited courses, lessons, quizzes, certificates, native checkout with Stripe, and basic email automation.

Do I need WooCommerce to sell courses?

No. Creator LMS includes native eCommerce with Stripe, Mollie, and offline payments built-in. You can start selling courses immediately without installing WooCommerce or any other eCommerce plugin. However, we’re adding optional WooCommerce integration soon for users who prefer it.

Can I issue certificates to students?

Yes. Creator LMS includes a certificate builder to create and issue professional completion certificates for each course. Certificates are automatically generated when students meet completion requirements.

Can I migrate courses from another LMS?

Absolutely. Creator LMS offers free migration tools for Tutor LMS, LearnDash, and LearnPress. We also support SCORM imports from any SCORM-compliant LMS. Our support team can assist with migration if needed.

What makes Creator LMS different from Tutor LMS or LearnDash?

Creator LMS is built specifically for creators, not institutions. We include native eCommerce (no WooCommerce required), cohort-based learning, built-in community platform, one-click upsells, and AI course generation—all in one plugin. Other LMS platforms require 5-10 paid add-ons to get similar features.

What’s included in the Pro version?

Pro adds: cohort-based courses, built-in community platform, AI Suite (course generation), gamification (badges, leaderboards), advanced email automation with Mail Mint, one-click offers, memberships and subscriptions, assignments, content protection, additional payment gateways (PayPal, Authorize.net, Razorpay), and premium integrations.

Can I run cohort-based courses?

Yes, with Creator LMS Pro. Create time-based cohorts where students start together and progress on a schedule. Perfect for group coaching, bootcamps, and live programs. Free version supports self-paced courses only.

Does Creator LMS have a community feature?

Yes, in Creator LMS Pro. Build discussion forums, Q&A sections, and member profiles without installing BuddyPress or separate community plugins. Everything is integrated into the LMS.

Can I use my own branding and design?

Absolutely. Creator LMS works with any WordPress theme and all major page builders (Elementor, Bricks, Gutenberg, WPBakery, uiXpress). Customize course layouts, colors, and branding to match your site.

Is Creator LMS suitable for beginners?

Yes! Creator LMS is designed for creators without technical backgrounds. The setup wizard guides you through configuration, course templates help you start quickly, and video tutorials cover every feature. You can launch your first course in under an hour.

What payment methods are supported?

Free version includes Stripe, Mollie, and offline payments. Pro adds PayPal, Authorize.net, and Razorpay. We’re also adding WooCommerce integration soon for access to 100+ payment gateways.

Can I create quizzes with multiple question types?

Yes. Creator LMS supports 6+ question types: multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blank, short answer, essay, and matching questions. Quizzes can have time limits, attempt limits, and pass/fail requirements.

Does Creator LMS work with my WordPress theme?

Yes. Creator LMS is designed to work with any properly-coded WordPress theme. We’ve tested compatibility with 30+ popular themes including Astra, GeneratePress, Kadence, OceanWP, and more.

Can I offer free and paid courses?

Yes. You can create free courses, paid courses, or mix both. Offer free introductory courses to build your audience, then upsell to premium paid courses.

How many courses can I create?

Unlimited. Both free and pro versions allow unlimited courses, lessons, quizzes, and students. No artificial limits.

Does Creator LMS slow down my website?

No. Creator LMS is built with performance in mind. The plugin is lightweight, follows WordPress coding standards, and is compatible with caching plugins. Most sites see no noticeable performance impact.

Can I have multiple instructors?

Yes. Creator LMS supports multiple instructors. Each instructor can create and manage their own courses, track their earnings, and manage their students.

Is there a mobile app for students?

Currently, Creator LMS is fully responsive on mobile browsers. A dedicated mobile app for iOS and Android is on our roadmap for Q2 2026.

How do I get support?

Free users get community forum support. Pro users get priority email support with faster response times. Visit our support forum or check our documentation.

Can I try Pro features before buying?

Check out our live demo to explore all Pro features. We also offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all Pro purchases.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Creator LMS plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.= Does Creator LMS support recurring subscriptions? =
Yes, in Creator LMS Pro. Create monthly, yearly, or custom subscription plans. Students can subscribe for ongoing access to courses or membership areas.

Can I integrate Creator LMS with my email marketing tool?

Yes. Creator LMS Pro integrates with Mail Mint for advanced email automation. You can also use webhooks to connect with Zapier, Make, and other automation platforms to integrate with any email marketing tool.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your course data remains in your WordPress database. If you reactivate Creator LMS later, all your courses, students, and settings will be exactly as you left them.

Can I export my course data?

Yes. You can export courses, student data, and order information to CSV files for backup or migration to other systems.

Does Creator LMS support video hosting?

Creator LMS works with self-hosted videos, YouTube, Vimeo, and any embeddable video source. Pro will add Amazon S3 integration for optimized video hosting.

How often is Creator LMS updated?

We release updates regularly—typically 1-2 major updates per quarter plus security patches as needed. All updates are free for both free and pro users.

👥 Cohort-Based Learning – Run Live Programs

Transform passive course consumption into active learning experiences with cohort-based courses where students learn together, on a schedule.

What Are Cohorts?

Cohorts are groups of students who start a course at the same time and progress through it together on a set schedule. Instead of self-paced learning, cohort-based courses create accountability, peer interaction, and higher completion rates.

Perfect For:

  • Group coaching programs
  • Bootcamp-style intensive courses
  • Mastermind communities
  • Corporate training sessions
  • Semester-based education
  • Live workshop series

Cohort Management Features

  • Set specific start and end dates for each cohort
  • Enroll students in specific cohorts
  • Create multiple cohorts for the same course
  • Manage waitlists for upcoming cohorts
  • Cohort-specific announcements and updates
  • Track progress for entire cohorts
  • Schedule content release by cohort

Higher Engagement, Better Results

Cohort-based courses create urgency (deadlines), accountability (peer progress), and community (shared experience). Students are 3-5x more likely to complete cohort-based courses vs. self-paced.

Monetization Benefits

Charge premium pricing for cohort access. Create scarcity with limited cohort sizes. Run multiple cohorts throughout the year for predictable recurring revenue.

Live Learning Integration

Schedule live sessions, Q&A calls, and group workshops within your cohort timeline. Students see upcoming live events on their dashboard and receive automatic reminders.
